messages:
pagerduty_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 429/503 rates on inference-prod cluster "us-west-1" starting 2025-07-12T03:20Z. See /alerts/INC-12345. Trigger: 429 rate > 5% sustained for 3m.

oncall_josh: I'm on it. paging team now. anyone seeing customer pages?

sre_amy: seeing spike in 429s and short 503 bursts. Top routes: /v1/embeddings (64%), /v1/generate (20%). Heatmap shows correlated burst from tenant t-42 and t-77. Latency stable but queue length high on pool gpu-pool-a.

infra_mike: probable KV cache misses + token-bucket exhaustion for large-request tenants. pulling up prom query.

sre_amy: prom query I ran:
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"4..|5..",job="inference"}[2m])) by (status,route)
```
results: 429s jumped to 120/min (baseline 4/min). 503 spikes ~30/min.

sre_amy: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/429-503-heatmap?orgId=1

oncall_josh: customer impact: Support shows ~15 open tickets, 3 high-severity customers reporting failed embeddings jobs. @support_lina can you confirm affected customers and whether any are enterprise-SLA?

support_lina: Yep, customers t-77 (enterprise), t-42 (startup), t-501 (internal test). Notified t-77 via email, they see 20% job failure. I'll escalate to CSM after we have mitigation.

engops_tara: suggest soft tenant shaping for the two noisy tenants and enable per-route QPS cap for embeddings. Can we push shaping via runtime flags?

infra_mike: runtime supports ephemeral per-tenant token cap. Command to apply:
```
redwoodctl tenant-shape set --tenant t-77 --route /v1/embeddings --qps 4 --burst 8 --reason "emergency-live-shape"
```
I can run that if we agree.

oncall_josh: do it for t-77 and t-42, and set global embeddings QPS floor to prevent cascading. @sre_amy watch dashboards.

sre_amy: applying now to t-77... done. queue length for gpu-pool-a down 30% within 45s. 429 rate for route dropped from 95/min to 18/min.

support_lina: notified t-77: they confirmed success, failures reduced. Posting in customer thread.

infra_mike: applying to t-42... done. Also toggled `enable_prefix_cache=true` on pool-A to reduce recompute; patched config via:
```
redwoodctl pool-config set --pool gpu-pool-a --enable-prefix-cache=true
```
effects should show up after 30s.

sre_amy: monitoring: overall 429s back to 12/min, 503s down to 4/min. Still elevated vs baseline but acceptable for 30m mitigation window. Recommend keeping shapes for 1 hour and then gradual rollback.

oncall_josh: tracking: created incident channel inc-12345, setting priority P1 -> P2 if no regressions. @engops_tara you're owner for rollback plan.

engops_tara: will prepare canary rollback: remove t-42 shaping first, monitor 10min, then t-77. Also propose to disable experimental "multi-embedding-batch" feature for all tenants to avoid batching bloat. Toggle:
```
feature_flag disable multi-embedding-batch --scope all --reason "live mitigation"
```
we should do that if we see re-spike.

sre_amy: quick note — telemetry shows KV cache hit rate low for these tenants; follow-up RCA likely around cache keys being too granular. Add to postmortem.

oncall_josh: paging summary for handoff to next oncall in 2h: actions_taken=["applied per-tenant shaping t-77,t-42","enabled prefix cache on gpu-pool-a","notified customers t-77,t-42","created incident inc-12345"]. I'll hand off with current metrics.

prod_telemetry: snapshot uploaded: https://telemetry.redwood/internal/snapshots/1755551234

oncall_josh: OK i'm going to step out for caffeine, @sre_amy you take lead. I'll leave a short handoff.

sre_amy: noted. continuing monitoring. if 429s exceed 30/min we'll enable global embeddings QPS cap and consider disabling streaming for large responses.

support_lina: drafted customer message for t-77 with ETA and mitigation summary.

pagerduty_bot: Reminder: next on-call rotation @oncall_rachael in 2h. Escalation policy unchanged.

oncall_josh: handoff: first_message=1755551234 last_message=1755551610

sre_amy: postmortem owner volunteered: @infra_mike.

engops_tara: also opening a follow-up task: https://tasks.redwood/internal/INC-12345-followup

support_lina: closing customer loop for t-77 as "mitigated". still monitoring for t-501.

End."
